# Agent rules for this repo

- Commits are not signed as authored by Mistral or any AI assistant. No
  author signatures of any kind are added — no `Co-Authored-By` trailers, no
  "Generated by ..." lines.

## Process management over SSH

- The remote shell running an `ssh host 'command'` has that ENTIRE command
  string in its own command line. Any `pgrep -f` / `pkill -f` pattern whose
  text occurs anywhere in the same command matches the session itself. That
  includes `cd` paths, log file arguments, and a `nohup ... &` launch in the
  same line. This repeatedly killed the SSH session itself or produced false
  "still running" readings.
- Rules:
  1. Managed services are stopped and restarted with
     `systemctl stop/restart <unit>`. pkill is never used on them.
  2. If pkill/pgrep over SSH is required, the exact process name is used
     (`pkill -x voice-assistant`). Or the kill is placed in its OWN ssh
     invocation containing nothing else. The pattern then cannot occur
     elsewhere in it.
  3. The `[b]racket` trick only protects the pattern itself. It does NOT
     protect against other literal occurrences of the target string in the
     same command line (e.g. the nohup launch). Any command that both matches
     and mentions a process is assumed broken.
